name: VPN Unlimited
blurb: VPN Unlimited is a cross-platform VPN service with no limits on traffic or connection speed.
description:
VPN Unlimited is a cross-platform VPN service with no limits on traffic or connection
speed. It encrypts your connection, hides your real IP address and lets you choose
where your traffic leaves the internet, across servers in more than 80 locations.

This Linux build is deliberately light. It installs no background service and no kernel
module: the tunnel is created through NetworkManager, the network service your system
already runs, using the WireGuard protocol. Settings live inside the Flatpak sandbox, so
removing the application removes them with it.

Features:

• WireGuard tunnel set up through NetworkManager - no daemon, no driver

• Servers in over 80 locations, with a recommended-server option

• Custom DNS, so you decide who resolves your names

• Works on Steam Deck in both Desktop and Game Mode

A VPN Unlimited account is required. You can create one from the application or on our
website.
